name: Gibeath-elohim
line: Gibeath-elohim, or Gibeah of God, is a city with a Philistine outpost where Saul met a group of prophets and the Spirit of God came upon him.

moments.title: Saul prophesies with the prophets
moments.text: When Saul and his servant arrive at Gibeah, a group of prophets meets him. The Spirit of God rushes upon Saul, and he prophesies along with them, so people who knew him ask, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
